חצבת ארה"ב מקרי מוות ניו יורק נובמבר 2026

sources_found.publisher: US CDC — Measles Cases and Outbreaks (data-research page)
sources_found.figures: 5,412 confirmed 2026 cases (5,394 from 47 jurisdictions + 18 international visitors); 43 outbreaks, ~96% outbreak-associated; 6 deaths nationally (subject to change). No per-state counts on page.

sources_found.publisher: New York State Department of Health + Lewis County Public Health (joint statement, via CIDRAP/CNN/AHA)
sources_found.figures: ONE measles-associated death (child, reported as unvaccinated 7-month-old, Lewis County) — the state's first in 30+ years. NY cases: 178 as of 2026-10-24; 210 through 2026-10-31 (per CIDRAP).
sources_found.readable_note: health.ny.gov returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch; figure taken from the joint statement as reported by CIDRAP (https://www.cidrap.umn.edu/measles/child-dies-measles-new-york-state-first-time-30-years) and CNN (https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/02/health/new-york-measles-death).

sources_found.publisher: Secondary: Medical Daily / PBS / CIDRAP on Pennsylvania deaths
sources_found.figures: Pennsylvania state officials confirmed 5 measles-associated deaths in 2026 (PA + NY combined = 6-7 depending on report date); CDC counted fewer for a period after excluding PA deaths from its weekly dashboard.

primary_source_search.notes: Multiple English + Hebrew searches found no report of a second New York measles death up to ~Nov 12. The 'several deaths' in 2026 are national, concentrated in Pennsylvania; New York has one.

body_fetch.note: curl: HTTP 403 (224 bytes). WebFetch: headline + navigation only, no articleBody/JSON-LD, no publication date.

claims.verified_figure: 5,412 confirmed US cases in 2026 as of 2026-11-12 (5,182 as of 2026-11-05); highest annual total since 1991
claims.note: 'Thousands' is a fair, if understated, description of a confirmed count above 5,000. No inflation of a smaller number.

claims.claim_text: נרשמו מספר מקרי מוות בניו יורק — headline
claims.verified_figure: 1 measles-associated death in New York State in 2026 (Lewis County child, announced 2026-11-02 by NYSDOH + Lewis County Public Health); 0 in NYC. Nationally: 6 per CDC (as of 2026-11-12), most of them in Pennsylvania (5 per PA officials).
claims.note: The NY health authority's own figure is a single death, not 'several'. The plural appears to fold national (largely Pennsylvania) deaths into a New York attribution. Body text unavailable, so whether the body clarifies this is unknown; the headline is verdicted on its own. NYSDOH page itself returned 403; figure taken from its joint statement as reported by CIDRAP/CNN, and multiple searches found no later NY death.
